Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence

Hello, I’m Jingyao.

I am Jingyao, and my friends and professors also call me Jennifer. I am currently a Postdoctoral Associate and an MIT–Novo Nordisk AI Postdoctoral Fellow (January 2025–January 2027), mentored by Prof. Rosalind Picard. I also work closely with Prof. Paul Pu Liang at the MIT Media Lab. Prior to this, I had quite a journey across continents.

I was born on February 14, 1998—a romantic day—in a small city in northern China. At 17, I moved to the southern side of the world, to the beautiful coastal city of Sydney, Australia, where I began my journey toward becoming an international scholar and researcher.

I received my B.E. (Hons) in Telecommunications Engineering with First Class Honours from the School of Electrical Engineering and Telecommunications at the University of New South Wales (UNSW) in 2020. During my undergraduate studies, I attended my first international conference, ICASSP 2019 in Brighton, UK, which inspired and motivated me to pursue a Ph.D.

I earned my Ph.D. in Signal Processing in 2024 under the supervision of Associate Professor Vidhyasaharan Sethu, Professor Eliathamby Ambikairajah, and Dr. Ting Dang. During my Ph.D., I published peer-reviewed papers at ICASSP, INTERSPEECH, ACII, and in IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing. This work includes a first-authored paper that received the Best Paper Award at ACII 2023 and a paper recognized among the Top 3% of papers at ICASSP 2023.

I truly cherish the experiences I have had throughout this journey, and I remain open to exploring and embracing new opportunities. I am actively seeking faculty positions—please feel free to reach out.

Research

Research interests

My research advances signal processing, machine learning, and artificial intelligence through three interconnected directions:

01

Smartly Handling Ambiguity and Uncertainty in Human-Centered AI

Investigating how uncertainty, ambiguity, and subjectivity affect AI-driven decision-making in mental health, speech technology, and affective computing to improve interpretability and trustworthiness.

02

Temporal-Aware Modelling for Emotion and Mental Health

Developing machine learning models to track temporal changes in emotional states and mental health conditions, enabling personalized monitoring and early forecasting of emotion fluctuations, depression severity, and well-being trajectories.

03

Speech and Multisensory Intelligence for Human Behaviour Modelling

Designing holistic frameworks that integrate speech with other modalities—video, text, and physiological signals—to enable more reliable and context-aware inference of human affect and behaviours that generalizes across real-world conditions.

Beyond research

Dance is my other language.

Outside the lab, I am a dancer. Movement gives me another way to explore expression, rhythm, collaboration, and storytelling.

01

Hip-hop

Energy, musicality, and confidence—finding freedom through rhythm and movement.

02

K-pop

Performing as part of a team, where precision, character, and shared energy come together.

03

Choreography

Turning music and ideas into movement, and shaping a story that can be felt as well as seen.
